== Boot device and rollback ==
Unraid boots from an internal boot pool (zfs), 1 device(s).
The boot pool has its own device(s).
Rollback after Debian is installed:
  - Debian on another device: switch the firmware boot order back.
  - Debian on this boot device: restore the Flash Backup zip to a USB stick (USB Flash Creator) and boot it.
There is no stick to keep: the Flash Backup zip is the rollback artifact.

== Capture ==
Written to /boot/config/hoserva/: containers.json, networks.json, disks.ini, autostart, var.ini, smart/, capture.json and this report.
Docker files are absent when Docker was not running; the capture says so.
The capture in /boot/config/hoserva/ contains your containers' environment variables, secrets included, like the templates on the same flash. The Flash Backup zip is as sensitive as the flash itself: keep it like the flash.
